This '''[[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]]''' was a member of a criminal organization called the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]]. He participated in the unsuccessful joint [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during a [[Eriadu Trade Summit|trade summit]] on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].
